adapters.purpose: Translate generated CLI availability into existing Citty command executors.
adapters.removalCondition: Every first-party CLI command exports a public Mod API command executor with equivalent Citty argument/help projection.

adapters.purpose: Translate generated TUI and intent availability into the existing parser result envelopes.
adapters.removalCondition: Every first-party intent parser and action is activated from its physical mod package.

adapters.purpose: Bind generated Cesar availability to existing capability implementations.
adapters.removalCondition: Cesar executes registry contribution payloads directly and all physical mods inject only public support capabilities.

adapters.purpose: Expose generated MCP availability through the existing JSON-RPC handlers without changing tool schemas or descriptions.
adapters.removalCondition: MCP dispatch invokes owner-tagged registry payloads directly and compatibility aliases have versioned replacements.

adapters.purpose: Render selected generated documentation with the established Agent Guide formatting.
adapters.removalCondition: Physical docs contributions contain all generated and preserved handwritten regions.
